questions.prompt: You and a villain both have ace-king. Board is paired. The pot…

choices.text: Is split if neither has a better five-card hand.
Goes to the player who tabled first.
Is awarded by the first verbal claim.

questions.explanation: Identical five-card hands chop, including kickers that do not play.

questions.prompt: Villain says 'two pair' but tables a straight. You should…

choices.text: Let the cards play; the straight stands.
Call the floor only if you dislike the player.

questions.explanation: Cards speak. A mistaken announcement does not kill a better hand.

questions.prompt: At showdown the aggressor is supposed to table first in many rooms. If they hesitate…

choices.text: Ask the dealer to control order; do not expose extra cards yourself.

questions.explanation: Follow the dealer. Do not touch another player's cards.

questions.prompt: Odd chips in a chopped pot are usually…

choices.text: Returned to the house as a tip automatically.
Left for the next hand's button always.
Awarded by a posted house rule, often to the first actor or the button side.

questions.explanation: Rooms differ. Do not invent a split; ask the dealer.
